primary_population: all 100 exhaustively unused train-split MMLU-Pro queries
primary_estimand: mean over queries of (five-draw mean quality of frozen selected route minus five-draw mean quality of R1)
scoring: common explicit-option parser; generation failures, truncations without an extractable answer, and parse failures score zero; no correctness-based retry
uncertainty: two-sided 95% prompt-group bootstrap CI with 2000 resamples and seed 42

decision_rule.supportive_only: primary point estimate > 0 but CI includes 0

secondary: conditional mean gain on the 10 queries routed away from R1
win/tie/loss counts on those switched queries
forbidden: changing Ridge alpha, embeddings, training labels, model pool, decisions, or panel after viewing confirmation outcomes
claiming Oracle Gap without collecting all four models
